{
  "title": "Editorial approvals expire after a configurable number of days",
  "intent": "An approval is valid for a configurable number of days (30 to start). Publishing or scheduling a page whose approval is older is refused with a message that asks for a new review, and the refusal is audited. Approving a review records the approval date.",
  "clauses": [
    {"use": "setting_in_range", "with": {"key": "publishing.review_max_age_days", "min": 1, "max": 365, "value": 30}},
    {"use": "function_contract", "with": {"function": "services/workflow.py::review_age_ok", "inputs": {"age_days": "int", "max_age_days": "int"}, "assume": "max_age_days >= 1", "ensures": "result == (0 <= age_days <= max_age_days)"}, "require": "L5"},
    {"use": "always_on_calls", "with": {"tools": ["publish_page", "schedule_publish"], "where": "approval_age(run, event.args.page_id) <= config('publishing.review_max_age_days')"}},
    {"use": "scenario", "with": {"case": {"agent": "orchestrator", "request": "Please publish the stale-approval page", "context": {"user_id": "bob", "page_id": "p11"}}, "expect": {"state": [["pages.p11.status", "==", "draft"]], "audit": [{"action": "publish_refused", "page_id": "p11", "count": 1}], "response_contains": ["new review"]}}},
    {"use": "scenario", "with": {"case": "PUB-01"}},
    {"use": "scenario", "with": {"case": "PUB-01", "fixture_patch": {"pages.p4.review.approved_on": "2026-09-28"}}},
    {"use": "function_in_layer", "with": {"function": "review_age_ok", "file": "services/workflow.py"}},
    {"use": "forbid_literal_in", "with": {"value": 30, "dirs": ["services/workflow.py", "tools", "skills"]}},
    {"use": "forbid_import_in", "with": {"module": "datetime", "dirs": ["tools", "harness"]}}
  ]
}
